subject: The 2AM habit of our top 1%
preview_text: How power users set up their workflow—and why you're missing it.

You already have the same engine. Same boost. Same minimal one-screen UI. The difference is they configured the auto-apply in the first minute. Now it's out of their way, like a calm utility. Open the app, tap the settings gear, turn on 'Auto-apply on headphone connect.' That's it.

Try it now. Open Volume Booster Pro, connect your headphones, and let the slider do its work. You'll never think about it again. P.S. The one-time pay option is still there—same unlock, zero nags. Your call.
